description: VodBox-pinned inline-hook runtimes that replace the opaque hook .so files packaged in unidbg-android:0.9.8.

actual_packaged_set.note: FOUR distinct libraries per ABI (8 total), not three. libdobby.so and libhookzz.so are separate distributed artifacts: libdobby.so carries DobbyHook/DobbyInstrument strings, while libhookzz.so is a different binary (GCC 4.9 build, libhookzz.so strings). Dobby is therefore the source for libdobby.so ONLY, never a substitute for libhookzz.so.
actual_packaged_set.correction: An earlier revision of this pin listed only 3 libs and described Dobby as a substitute for the packaged libhookzz.so. Retained jar evidence disproves that; hookzz is now tracked separately and fails closed.

why_replace: The packaged hook binaries were imported over unidbg history, not built from a pinned manifest in the release. xHook was bumped to v1.1.12 but BOTH ABIs changed again without source/build provenance (REPORT.md). Exact historical source is not recoverable from public evidence; a pinned self-build is the defensible replacement.

dobby.commit_source: Tag 'latest' resolves to this commit (dobby-tags.json). Current reference only; historical HookZz version/license is NOT established.
dobby.build: CMake, target 'dobby' (SHARED) -> libdobby.so; matches the packaged artifact of the same name

hookzz.commit_source: SOURCE REVISION UNRESOLVED. Retained evidence (upstream-evidence/native-provenance/hookzz-*.json) does not pin the historical HookZz revision, and the packaged libhookzz.so is byte-distinct from libdobby.so.
hookzz.license_source: jmpews/HookZz was renamed to jmpews/Dobby; the project LICENSE (present from the current-master root commit 400ad4f2384c, 2018-10-10) and every mirror fork (zzscc/killvxk/panhongwei/loveezu/3kyo0) are byte-identical 11356-byte Apache-2.0 (SHA-256 43070e2d4e532684de521b885f385d0841030efa2b1a20bafb76133a5e1379c1). Retained at dependency-notices/unidbg-android-0.9.8/upstream-reference/hookzz/LICENSE (see upstream-reference/NOTICE-SOURCES.md).
hookzz.disposition_basis: source-revision-only (the LICENSE is known Apache-2.0 / notice-only; only the exact historical source revision is unresolved)
hookzz.fail_closed: No pinned source => libhookzz.so is not built and must be dropped from distribution. It must NEVER be satisfied by copying libdobby.so into its place; that would ship an unverified ABI under a name the emulator loads by that name.
hookzz.why_not_dobby: Dobby is HookZz's successor but is not ABI-identical to the packaged libhookzz.so; compatibility is not assumed (rebuild-lock.json abi_compat_check_required). Note: Dobby and HookZz share the same Apache-2.0 LICENSE, but the BINARIES are distinct.

xhook.commit_source: Annotated tag v1.1.12 peels to this commit (dependency-sources/upstream-evidence/native-provenance/xhook-tag-refs.txt). This is a grounded candidate, explicitly NOT the proved final binary source.
xhook.license: MIT + BSD-2-Clause (tree.h) + BSD-3-Clause (queue.h); LICENSE-docs retained separately
xhook.build: ndk-build -C libxhook/jni (module 'xhook'), NOT cmake; the pinned tree has no CMakeLists.txt

whale.commit_source: Current upstream HEAD observed via git ls-remote (whale-head-ref.txt). Current reference only, not a claim it built the historical libwhale.so.

license_facts: Per the retained binaries + upstream texts (see ../../dependency-notices/unidbg-android-0.9.8/GUEST-NATIVE-LICENSE-FACTS.md): libxhook.so = MIT + BSD-2 (tree.h) + BSD-3 (queue.h) + CC-BY-4.0 docs, notice-only; libwhale.so = Apache-2.0 (Apache also carries a NOTICE), notice-only; libdobby.so = Apache-2.0, notice-only; libhookzz.so = LICENSE UNKNOWN (HookZz is Dobby's predecessor, no HookZz license text retained, historical revision unresolved) -> cannot be satisfied by notice -> rebuild-or-drop. All hook licenses are permissive/notice-based; none is GPL. The historical revision of each (vs the pinned reference) is NOT proven, so the retained reference commit is a reference, not a proof of the shipped binary's source.
not_claimed: That these builds byte-match the packaged hook libs in unidbg-android:0.9.8.
That the historical HookZz revision or license is established.
That Dobby is drop-in ABI-compatible with the packaged libhookzz.so without a runtime check.
